name: tracks
js: a.drive.ctl.autoDrive = false; a.drive.sim.input.brake = 1; a.drive.cam.yawOff = 2.7; a.drive.cam.pitchOff = 0.55; a.drive.cam.distance = 9;

name: bury
js: const t = a.assets.data, s = a.drive.sim; let best = null; for (let r = 20; r < 700 && !best; r += 15) for (let k = 0; k < 24; k++) { const x = s.pos.x + Math.cos(k / 24 * 6.283) * r, z = s.pos.z + Math.sin(k / 24 * 6.283) * r; const sl = t.slopeDegAt(x, z); if (sl > 17 && sl < 23 && t.looseAt(x, z) > 0.8) { best = [x, z]; break; } } if (best) { const [x, z] = best; const gx = t.heightAt(x + 2, z) - t.heightAt(x - 2, z), gz = t.heightAt(x, z + 2) - t.heightAt(x, z - 2); a.drive.sim.reset(x, z, Math.atan2(gx, -gz) * 180 / Math.PI); a.drive.grid.follow(x, z, true); } s.mode = '2H'; s.gear = 1; s.input.brake = 0; s.setPressure(40); a.drive.ctl.autoDrive = true; a.drive.cam.yawOff = 0.9; a.drive.cam.pitchOff = 0.35; window.__bury = best;

name: bury_close
js: a.drive.ctl.autoDrive = false; a.drive.cam.yawOff = 1.4; a.drive.cam.pitchOff = 0.25; a.drive.cam.distance = 5.5; console.log('BURY ' + JSON.stringify({ beached: a.drive.sim.beached, sink: a.drive.sim.wheels.map(w => +w.sink.depth.toFixed(2)), body: Math.round(a.drive.sim.bodyContactLoad), at: window.__bury }));
